tools.name: COMPOSIO_GET_TOOL_SCHEMAS
tools.description: Get the input schemas for approved action slugs returned by the search tool. Pass the search result session_id unchanged.

tools.name: COMPOSIO_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL
tools.description: Execute approved action slugs with arguments that match schemas returned by the schema tool. Pass the search result session_id unchanged.

tools.name: COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS
tools.description: Search this Session's approved provider actions by the task to perform. Always include session: { generate_id: true } for a new workflow, then retrieve a returned action's schema before executing it.
